newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$5.00/cubic metre or C$0.79/barrel, to C$202.00/cubic metre or C$32.12/barrel, effective immediately.

Other new prices were listed as follows: Cromer light sour C$198.00/cubic metre, or C$31.48/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$178.00/cubic metre, or C$28.30/barrel Midale at Cromer C$188.00/cubic metre, or C$29.89/barrel -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
